extracted.intended_audience: Wolfram Language / Mathematica users and notebook authors writing formatted expressions and graphics
extracted.subtask_description: Reference for using the Wolfram Language Style function to format expressions and graphics in notebooks; documents syntax, allowed spec types, named styles, option precedence, nesting behavior, and many specific options with examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose / basic syntax
rubrics_metrics.description: Style[expr, options] displays expr formatted using the specified option settings. Style[expr, "style"] uses the option settings for the specified style in the current notebook. Style[expr, color] displays using the specified color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style can be used in ordinary expressions and graphics; you can supply directives like Bold, Italic, Underlined, Larger, Smaller, or a numeric size n to control font size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed spec types in Style
rubrics_metrics.description: Each spec_i in Style[expr, spec1, spec2, …] may be any of: explicit option settings (opt->val,...), a named style string ("style"), a color directive (Red, RGBColor[…], …), a graphics directive (Thickness[…], …), Bold/Italic/Underlined/Larger/Smaller, a number n for font size, or lists of graphics directives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style can use any option listed in the Option Inspector and any graphics directive or list of graphics directives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explicit settings override named styles
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit settings given in an object override default options defined by named styles included in the same object.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This override behavior holds regardless of the order in which explicit settings and named styles occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: First occurrence wins for explicit settings
rubrics_metrics.description: For explicit settings, the first occurrence of a setting for a given option is the one used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the same option is given multiple times explicitly in the spec sequence, the earliest one takes effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directives treated as equivalent to option settings
rubrics_metrics.description: Directives such as Red or Bold are treated as equivalent to their corresponding option settings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can use directive forms (e.g., Bold) instead of explicit options (FontWeight->"Bold").

rubrics_metrics.name: Nested Style precedence
rubrics_metrics.description: When Style objects are nested, the specifications of the innermost one control the display of a particular expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inner Style overrides outer Style for the same display property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style scope (Scope examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Style affects ordinary expressions and graphic objects; examples show setting font size in points, specifying font properties, using graphics directives, and text indentation/spacing/alignment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Style to control both textual and graphic element appearance; see examples for concrete usage patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to use Option Inspector options
rubrics_metrics.description: Style can use any option listed in the Option Inspector in the notebook front end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This means Style can control a very wide range of presentation and behavior options beyond fonts and colors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Named styles available
rubrics_metrics.description: A set of common named styles can be supplied as a string, e.g., "Button", "Graphics", "Input", "Label", "Menu", "Output", "Panel", "PopupMenu", "Section", "SmallText", "Subsection", "Text", "Title".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using a named style applies the option settings defined for that style in the current stylesheet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Antialiasing
rubrics_metrics.description: Control whether antialiasing is used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use antialiasing by default or turn off antialiasing with the Antialiasing option (examples provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify background colors for the styled expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Background can be set to color values to highlight or panel elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: ControlsRendering
rubrics_metrics.description: Affects appearance of controls such as Slider and RadioButton when styled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples compare default and generic appearances of Slider and RadioButton under ControlsRendering settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: DefaultOptions interaction
rubrics_metrics.description: DefaultOptions can be set locally; explicit option settings in an object override default options for that type of object.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can set DefaultOptions temporarily with Style-wrapped expressions to change defaults locally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deployed
rubrics_metrics.description: Disable general editing and selection in a cell while preserving interactive controls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Deployed->True to make content non-editable but remain interactive where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: DigitBlock / Number formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: DigitBlock controls grouping of integer digits (e.g., blocks of 3 separated by comma).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use DigitBlock->3 and NumberSeparator->"," to format large integers for readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editable
rubrics_metrics.description: Controls whether the contents of an output cell are editable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By default an output cell is editable; set Editable->False to make it noneditable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enabled
rubrics_metrics.description: Control whether interactive elements are enabled or disabled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare enabled and disabled Slider/RadioButton examples to show effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: FontColor
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify font color for the styled expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show using red font color and specifying color via option or directive.

rubrics_metrics.name: FontFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the font family (e.g., "Courier", "Times", "Helvetica").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use FontFamily->"Courier" to force monospaced text, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: FontSize
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the font size in printer's points or via predefined symbolic sizes (Tiny, Small, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can use numeric point sizes or symbolic names such as Tiny, Small, Larger, Smaller; numeric n sets FontSize->n.

rubrics_metrics.name: FontSlant
rubrics_metrics.description: Control font slant (e.g., plain or italic).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show plain fonts and italic fonts and how to set FontSlant explicitly or via Italic directive.

rubrics_metrics.name: FontTracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjust tracking (spacing) of fonts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different settings for FontTracking can be applied to change letter spacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: FontVariations
rubrics_metrics.description: Use font variation features such as underlined text, strike-through, or combinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show Underlined, Strike-through, and combining both via FontVariations or directives.

rubrics_metrics.name: FontWeight
rubrics_metrics.description: Set font weight (e.g., plain or Bold).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use FontWeight->"Bold" or Bold directive to emphasize text.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImageSizeMultipliers
rubrics_metrics.description: Scale size of graphics inside lists or functions relative to normal size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify that the graphic inside a list is 0.4 times normal size or 0.2 times inside a function via ImageSizeMultipliers.

rubrics_metrics.name: LineIndent
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify indentation size for text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include no indentation vs specified indent amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: LineSpacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Control line spacing and extra space added to each line.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show double spacing and single spacing with extra points added per line.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magnification
rubrics_metrics.description: Set magnification level that affects everything including margins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Magnification->n scales the display of the styled content.

rubrics_metrics.name: NumberSeparator
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify characters used to separate digit blocks in formatted numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine with DigitBlock to format numbers with separators like ",".

rubrics_metrics.name: ScriptBaselineShifts
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjust default placement of subscripts and superscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can shift subscripts down or superscripts up by specified x-heights to tweak appearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: ScriptMinSize
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep exponents from shrinking below a certain font size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ScriptMinSize to prevent scripts from becoming too small in deeply nested exponents.

rubrics_metrics.name: ScriptSizeMultipliers
rubrics_metrics.description: Set the factor by which font size is reduced for superscripts and subscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ScriptSizeMultipliers->list uses different factors for different script levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: ShowStringCharacters
rubrics_metrics.description: Control whether quotation marks are shown around strings in output cells.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By default quotes are shown in input but not output; set ShowStringCharacters->True to show them in outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: SingleLetterItalics
rubrics_metrics.description: Make variables with one-letter names appear italicized or override this behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SingleLetterItalics to enforce or override single-letter italicization in TraditionalForm or other outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: TextAlignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Align text left, center, or right within the styled region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show left, centered, and right alignment settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples and practical patterns
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation provides basic examples: using red font color; specifying various font properties; using a predefined style; specifying the style of individual graphic objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Basic Examples and Scope sections for pattern recipes for common formatting tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use with graphics directives
rubrics_metrics.description: Style can accept graphics directives and lists of graphics directives to affect graphic objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show using Thickness and other graphic directives inside Style for graphic element appearance.
